description.value: Pokey Okey is a local Vancouver poke bowl chain founded in 2018, now with three locations across the metro area. The Kingsway outpost serves Hawaiian-style poke bowls built from fresh fish and locally sourced vegetables, with signature sauces and a range of customizable toppings. It sits on a major arterial cycling corridor in East Vancouver, making it a convenient stop for riders passing through the area.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 24m; stands (1 space) at 53m; stands (1 space) at 65m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Kingsway location at 2421 Kingsway with phone (604) 416-4318, matching OSM. Takeout/pickup is explicitly offered ('Order for Pickup') for this location. The OSM name includes 'Shokudo' (Japanese for dining hall/restaurant) which does not appear anywhere on the website, which only uses 'Pokey Okey' and labels this branch 'East Vancouver (Kingsway)' — flagged as a name discrepancy. No cyclist-specific amenity information (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) appears on the website.
concerns: OSM name 'Pokey Okey Shokudo' includes the word 'Shokudo' (Japanese for dining hall/restaurant), which does not appear anywhere on the business website; the brand is consistently presented as 'Pokey Okey' only. OSM name may be informally extended by the tagger.
OSM opening hours differ from hours shown on the website for the Kingsway location; OSM data may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant confirmed by website with a matching address on a major cycling corridor in East Vancouver. No grounds for exclusion.
